summary: Fix trackpad PDF pinch zoom jumping, restore plain scrolling, and keep zoomed-out pages centered.

budget_impact.rationale: Deterministic client-side geometry only; no model call, network behavior, storage schema, or budget operation changed.
budget_impact.before: Pinch zoom used page offset * scale - pointer offset, causing a release jump.
budget_impact.after: The complete pointer anchor is scaled consistently before and after re-render; plain wheel scrolling is left native; the visual and crisp surfaces retain viewport-width centering when zoomed out.

open_risks: Automated checks cover the geometry and event contracts; the packaged macOS app was rebuilt, signed, restarted, and visually inspected, but a physical pinch gesture remains a manual user-level check.
